data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'Geoffrey' meaning 'pledge of God', or 'God's peace'. This name gained popularity in the Middle Ages and was borne by many noble figures in Europe. The name Jeff carries the meaning “God's peace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jeff usually hope their child will grow to embody god's peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's presence and peace in one's life.
data.etymology: Jeff belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's peace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeff total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
